/*
 * Powder Diffractometer - McStas 3.x
 * Rebuilt from specification with all derived quantities and beamline components
 */

DEFINE INSTRUMENT PowderDiffractometer(
  double lambda = 2.5666,
  double R = 0.87,
  double R_curve = 0.87,
  string filename = "Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz",
  double D_PHI = 6,
  double SHIFT = 0,
  double PACK = 0.7,
  double Dw = 0.8,
  double BARNS = 1,
  int SPLITS = 58
)

DECLARE
%{
  /* Derived constants */
  double mono_q = 1.8734;
  double y_mono = 0.025;
  int NV = 5;
  double sample_radius = 0.008/2;
  double sample_height = 0.03;
  double can_radius = 0.0083/2;
  double can_height = 0.0303;
  double can_thick = 0.00015;
  double Qc = 0.0217;
  double R0 = 0.995;
  double Mvalue = 1.9;
  double W = 1.0/250.0;
  double Qc_curve = 0.0217;
  double R0_curve = 0.995;
  double Mvalue_curve = 2.1;
  double W_curve = 1.0/250.0;
  double ldiff = 0.05;
  
  /* Computed at startup */
  double TTM, OMA, RV, angleGuideCurved, alpha, alpha_curve;
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
  TTM = 2*asin(mono_q*lambda/(4*M_PI))*RAD2DEG;
  OMA = TTM/2;
  RV = fabs(2*2.82*sin(DEG2RAD*OMA));
  
  angleGuideCurved = -2.0*asin(0.4995/2.0/3612)/M_PI*180;
  alpha = (R0-R)/Qc/(Mvalue-1);
  alpha_curve = (R0_curve-R_curve)/Qc_curve/(Mvalue_curve-1);
  
  printf("Instrument parameters:\n");
  printf("  lambda = %g Å\n", lambda);
  printf("  TTM = %g deg, OMA = %g deg, RV = %g\n", TTM, OMA, RV);
  printf("  alpha = %g, alpha_curve = %g\n", alpha, alpha_curve);
%}

TRACE

COMPONENT source_arm = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT source = Source_Maxwell_3(
  yheight = 0.156,
  xwidth = 0.126,
  Lmin = lambda - ldiff/2,
  Lmax = lambda + ldiff/2,
  dist = 1.5,
  focus_xw = 0.02,
  focus_yh = 0.12,
  T1 = 296.16,
  T2 = 40.68,
  I1 = 8.5e11,
  I2 = 5.2e11
)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE source_arm

COMPONENT PSDbefore_guides = PSD_monitor(
  nx = 128,
  ny = 128,
  filename = "PSDbefore_guides",
  xwidth = 0.02,
  yheight = 0.12,
  restore_neutron = 1
)
  AT [0, 0, 1.49999] RELATIVE source_arm

COMPONENT l_mon_source = L_monitor(
  nL = 101,
  filename = "lmonsource.dat",
  xwidth = 0.02,
  yheight = 0.12,
  Lmin = 0,
  Lmax = 20,
  restore_neutron = 1
)
  AT [0, 0, 1e-9] RELATIVE PSDbefore_guides

COMPONENT guide1 = Guide(
  w1 = 0.02,
  h1 = 0.12,
  w2 = 0.02,
  h2 = 0.12,
  l = 4.66,
  R0 = R0,
  Qc = Qc,
  alpha = alpha,
  m = 1.8,
  W = W
)
  AT [0, 0, 1.50] RELATIVE source_arm

COMPONENT PSDbefore_curve = PSD_monitor(
  nx = 128,
  ny = 128,
  filename = "PSDbefore_curve",
  xwidth = 0.02,
  yheight = 0.12,
  restore_neutron = 1
)
  AT [0, 0, 4.664] RELATIVE guide1

COMPONENT guide2 = Bender(
  w = 0.02,
  h = 0.12,
  r = 3612,
  l = 20,
  R0a = R0_curve,
  Qca = Qc_curve,
  alphaa = alpha_curve,
  ma = Mvalue_curve,
  Wa = W_curve,
  R0i = R0_curve,
  Qci = Qc_curve,
  alphai = alpha_curve,
  mi = 1,
  Wi = W_curve,
  R0s = R0_curve,
  Qcs = Qc_curve,
  alphas = alpha_curve,
  ms = Mvalue_curve,
  Ws = W_curve
)
  AT [0, 0, 4.69] RELATIVE guide1

COMPONENT PSDafter_curve = PSD_monitor(
  nx = 128,
  ny = 128,
  filename = "PSDafter_curve",
  xwidth = 0.02,
  yheight = 0.12,
  restore_neutron = 1
)
  AT [0, 0, 20.0001] RELATIVE guide2

COMPONENT bunker = Guide(
  w1 = 0.02,
  h1 = 0.12,
  w2 = 0.02,
  h2 = 0.12,
  l = 3.43,
  R0 = R0,
  Qc = Qc,
  alpha = alpha,
  m = 1.6,
  W = W
)
  AT [0, 0, 20.1502] RELATIVE guide2

COMPONENT guide3 = Guide(
  w1 = 0.02,
  h1 = 0.12,
  w2 = 0.02,
  h2 = 0.12,
  l = 12.275,
  R0 = R0,
  Qc = Qc,
  alpha = alpha,
  m = 1.6,
  W = W
)
  AT [0, 0, 3.56] RELATIVE bunker

COMPONENT guide4 = Guide(
  w1 = 0.02,
  h1 = 0.12,
  w2 = 0.02,
  h2 = 0.12,
  l = 5.66,
  R0 = R0,
  Qc = Qc,
  alpha = alpha,
  m = 1.6,
  W = W
)
  AT [0, 0, 15.8555] RELATIVE bunker

COMPONENT window1 = Al_window(
  thickness = 0.002
)
  AT [0, 0, 5.66 + 1e-9] RELATIVE guide4

COMPONENT ydist_fluxpos = PSDlin_monitor(
  nbins = 11,
  filename = "ydist_fluxpos.dat",
  xwidth = 0.120,
  yheight = 0.02,
  restore_neutron = 1
)
  AT [0, 0, 5.66 + 1e-8 + 0.01] RELATIVE guide4
  ROTATED [0, 0, 90] RELATIVE window1

COMPONENT PSD_fluxpos = PSD_monitor(
  nx = 100,
  ny = 100,
  filename = "xdist_fluxposy.dat",
  xwidth = 0.02,
  yheight = 0.12,
  restore_neutron = 1
)
  AT [0, 0, 5.66 + 1e-7 + 0.01] RELATIVE guide4

COMPONENT xdist_flux_pos = PSDlin_monitor(
  nbins = 11,
  filename = "xdist_fluxpos.dat",
  xwidth = 0.020,
  yheight = 0.12,
  restore_neutron = 1
)
  AT [0, 0, 1e-9] RELATIVE PSD_fluxpos

COMPONENT PSD_fluxposB = PSD_monitor(
  nx = 100,
  ny = 100,
  filename = "PSD_fluxposB.dat",
  xwidth = 0.02,
  yheight = 0.12,
  restore_neutron = 1
)
  AT [0, 0, 6.24 - 1e-7 - 0.01] RELATIVE guide4

COMPONENT window2 = Al_window(
  thickness = 0.002
)
  AT [0, 0, 1e-9] RELATIVE PSD_fluxposB

COMPONENT in_slit = Slit(
  xmin = -0.01,
  xmax = 0.01,
  ymin = -0.06,
  ymax = 0.06
)
  AT [0, 0, 0.0021] RELATIVE window2

COMPONENT lambda_in = L_monitor(
  nL = 128,
  filename = "L_in.dat",
  xmin = -0.011,
  xmax = 0.011,
  ymin = -0.061,
  ymax = 0.061,
  Lmin = 0,
  Lmax = 2*lambda,
  restore_neutron = 1
)
  AT [0, 0, 0.001] RELATIVE in_slit

COMPONENT sma = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, 0.65] RELATIVE in_slit
  ROTATED [0, OMA, 0] RELATIVE in_slit

COMPONENT foc_mono = Monochromator_2foc(
  zwidth = 0.05,
  yheight = 0.025,
  gap = 0.0005,
  NH = 1,
  NV = 5,
  mosaich = 38,
  mosaicv = 38,
  r0 = 0.7,
  Q = mono_q,
  RV = RV,
  RH = 0
)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sma
  SPLIT SPLITS

COMPONENT msa = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sma
  ROTATED [0, TTM, 0] RELATIVE in_slit

COMPONENT out1_slit = Slit(
  xmin = -0.01,
  xmax = 0.01,
  ymin = -0.06,
  ymax = 0.06
)
  AT [0, 0, 0.2] RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT Amoin_slit = Slit(
  xmin = -0.01,
  xmax = 0.01,
  ymin = -0.06,
  ymax = 0.06
)
  AT [0, 0, 0.325] RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT Bmoin_slit = Slit(
  xmin = -0.01,
  xmax = 0.01,
  ymin = -0.06,
  ymax = 0.06
)
  AT [0, 0, 0.525] RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT out2_slit = Slit(
  xmin = -0.01,
  xmax = 0.01,
  ymin = -0.06,
  ymax = 0.06
)
  AT [0, 0, 0.65] RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT PSD_sample = PSD_monitor(
  nx = 80,
  ny = 80,
  filename = "PSD_sample.dat",
  xmin = -0.05,
  xmax = 0.05,
  ymin = -0.07,
  ymax = 0.07,
  restore_neutron = 1
)
  AT [0, 0, 2.77] RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT lambda_sample = L_monitor(
  nL = 128,
  filename = "L_sample.dat",
  xmin = -sample_radius,
  xmax = sample_radius,
  ymin = -sample_height/2,
  ymax = sample_height/2,
  Lmin = lambda - 0.2,
  Lmax = lambda + 0.2,
  restore_neutron = 1
)
  AT [0, 0, 2.81] RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT sa_arm = Arm()
  AT [0, 0, 2.82] RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT sample = PowderN(
  reflections = filename,
  radius = sample_radius,
  yheight = sample_height,
  pack = PACK,
  p_inc = 0,
  p_transmit = 0,
  DW = Dw,
  d_phi = D_PHI,
  barns = BARNS
)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sa_arm

COMPONENT STOP = Beamstop(
  radius = 0.3
)
  AT [0, 0, 1.4] RELATIVE sa_arm

COMPONENT Detector = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth = 3.0,
  yheight = 0.09,
  bins = 400,
  min = 19.9 + SHIFT,
  max = 99.9 + SHIFT,
  options = "banana,theta",
  filename = "detector.dat",
  restore_neutron = 1
)
  AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sa_arm
  ROTATED [0, 0, 180] RELATIVE sa_arm

END
